workout_summary: Planned: Shoulders + Arms (hotel gym, away from home equipment)

planned_workout.note: Hotel equipment only: dumbbells up to 20kg, kettlebells 8/12/16kg, one adjustable dual-pulley cable station. Push/pull program ratio is still 1.58x push-heavy, so favor the pull-side shoulder/arm work (face pulls, shrugs, curls) and keep pressing/triceps volume light rather than chasing weight — this is a maintenance session while traveling, not a PR attempt.

exercises.name: Cable Face Pull (rope, pulley station)
exercises.last: N/A at hotel — replaces Rear Delt Machine (home last: 73kg × 3×9)
exercises.target: Light-moderate cable × 4×15, slow squeeze at the back
exercises.reasoning: No rear delt machine here — this is the closest pull-corrector substitute and the single most important move today given the push-heavy ratio.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shrugs
exercises.target: 20kg each (hotel max) × 4×12, 1-2s hold at the top
exercises.reasoning: Direct pull-corrector carryover — capped by the hotel's 20kg dumbbells, so add a pause at the top to make up for the lighter load.

exercises.name: Lateral Raises (dumbbell or 12kg kettlebell)
exercises.reasoning: Neutral for push/pull (shoulders only) — just keep it moving for shoulder width/health.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.reasoning: A push-worsening movement per the standing correction — keep it in for shoulder strength but deliberately light and lower-volume today, not a max effort.

exercises.name: Farmer's Hold (kettlebell)
exercises.reasoning: Neutral (forearms/traps) — hotel kettlebells cap lower than home's dumbbells, so lean on time-under-tension instead of load.

exercises.name: Incline Hammer Curl
exercises.reasoning: Matches the hotel dumbbell cap exactly — pull-side (biceps), keep it a priority.

exercises.name: Cable Curl (straight bar or rope, pulley station)
exercises.last: N/A at hotel — replaces Biceps Curl Machine (home last: 45kg × 2×6)
exercises.reasoning: Another pull-side (biceps) substitute, prioritized alongside the curls above per the standing push/pull correction.

exercises.name: Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension
exercises.reasoning: Push-side (triceps) — kept for balance but deliberately fewer sets than usual while the ratio corrects.
